verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and project-management product, not a coding agent or browser-automation tool. Having an agent implement code, navigate the resulting app, and capture before-and-after screenshots to verify its work is outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence (Rovo AI automations, APIs, integrations, MCP server) shows Jira itself doing browser-driven verification, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
